categories.name: PAP Pipeline (Verdikt)
categories.description: Three-stage decision pipeline (extract, retrieve, reason) from raw enrollment packet to structured JSON verdict with rule citations.

features.name: Intake extraction (nv-ingest, multimodal)
features.description: Vision-language extraction over mixed PDFs, images, and OCR'd faxes. Runs on Nebius AI Cloud VM.

features.name: Program-configurable extraction schema
features.description: Each Program row carries a JSONB extraction_schema; adding a program is a data change, not a build.

features.name: Rule retrieval (NeMo Retriever NIMs)
features.description: pgvector store seeded from rules/*.yaml. nv-embedqa-e5-v5 + nv-rerankqa-mistral-4b-v3 rerank.

features.name: Structured reason stage (Nemotron)
features.description: Non-reasoning Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory emits a strict pydantic Decision. Non-reasoning mode is deliberate.

features.name: Decisions with rule + history citations
features.description: Every fired rule attached with rerank score. Citation type discriminates rule vs history.

features.name: Missing-info handling
features.description: Missing_fields list surfaces required slots not present in the extracted intake.

features.name: Orchestrator (async gather)
features.description: retrieve() + source.lookup() fire under a single asyncio.gather; extras merge without polluting Intake.

features.name: Routing-table instrumentation
features.description: Every model call stamped with model name, tokens in/out, latency, per-call cost. Rendered at /ui/admin/routing.

features.name: Second-program cameo (OncoBridge)
features.description: Different rules pack, opposite verdict, same code. Proof the pipeline generalises.

features.name: Deterministic render boundary
features.description: docgen.core never imports docgen.providers. AI-in, deterministic-out. Enforced in tests, not comments.

features.name: MDM lookup: parallel retrieval seam
features.description: PR1 landed 2026-09-13. NullMdmSource + protocol + history schema wired into orchestrator.

features.name: MDM slot compiler (references_slots)
features.description: Pure fn (events, slot_defs) -> [HistorySlot]. Kinds: bool, latest_outcome, days_since_latest, count. Orchestrator appends history citations for fired slots.

features.name: Per-tenant model selection
features.notes: Each tenant/program can pin its own extract, decision, and verifier models. Adds program.verifier_model + program.extract_model overrides on top of the tenant defaults.

features.name: PDF labeler: VLM vision mode (chunked + cropped)
features.notes: MiniCPM-V labels form fields via chunked page batches with per-widget crops when the whole-page pass fails. Handles dense flat forms that the widget-index approach mislabeled.

features.name: Triage stage — LLM classifier + case-type router
features.notes: Nemotron Nano on Nebius classifies each case into (new_intake, refill, appeal, missing_info_reply, not_decidable) and routes accordingly (refill → Pharmacy OMS, missing-info → CRM outreach, new intake → Decide, etc.). Rule-based deterministic classifier is the safety net when the LLM call fails or returns low confidence. Model and routing table configurable per tenant and per program.

features.name: 3-level model fallback chain (program → tenant → settings)
features.notes: Every pipeline stage (extract, triage, retrieve, reason, verifier) resolves its model by walking program → tenant → settings. Tenants gain default columns for all 5 stages; programs override individually. Same pattern for triage_routing (case_type → route map). Non-null values at higher precedence override lower ones; NULL falls through.

features.name: Tenant admin UI — pipeline model defaults + triage routing
features.notes: Super-admin page at /ui/admin/tenants/{id}/models. Editable model fields for all 5 stages with platform-default placeholders. Editable triage routing table (5 case_types × 5 routes). Saves only rows that differ from the platform default so the JSONB stays minimal.

features.name: Program admin UI — Triage model + routing overrides + effective-chain panel
features.notes: Program detail page now shows a Triage model input alongside Extract/Reason, plus a Triage routing table that inherits from the tenant. "What the pipeline uses today" panel shows the resolved chain per stage with a source label (program / tenant / settings).

features.name: Operator-configurable triage routing (dynamic rows + skip-Decide flag)
features.notes: Program-detail page now has a "Triage routing" tab with a dynamic table: operators add/remove rows, name their own case types, pick a downstream route, and toggle a "Decision needed?" flag per row. When the flag is off, the orchestrator skips the Decide stage entirely and emits a stub Decision carrying the route (refill straight to Pharmacy OMS, not-decidable straight to reject, etc.). LLM prompt is built dynamically from the configured case_types so program-specific types are classifiable.

features.name: Program page — "Inherit from tenant" toggle per model field
features.notes: Each of the four model dropdowns (Extract, Reason, Triage, Verifier) is paired with a checkbox that, when ticked, disables the dropdown and stores NULL on the program row so the resolver falls back to the tenant/platform default. The row displays the currently-resolved value with its source (program / tenant / settings) so operators can see what they'd inherit before unchecking. Inherit state is per-field, not all-or-nothing.

features.name: Program page — "Inherit routing from tenant" toggle for Triage
features.notes: Whole-table inherit toggle on the program's Triage tab. Checked (default when no override exists) disables every row and hides the Add-row button; unchecking enables the dynamic table. On submit with the toggle checked, the JS sends an empty payload and the handler clears program.triage_routing to NULL so the resolver walks up to tenant/platform routing.

features.name: Tenant admin split — dedicated Triage routing page
features.notes: Tenant Models page is now models-only; the routing table lives at /ui/admin/tenants/{id}/triage-routing with its own dynamic-rows editor. Tenant list page swaps text-link actions for a row of icon buttons (Inbox / MDM / Models / Triage / Quotas / Keys) with CSS-only tooltips so operator context stays compact and CSP-safe.

features.name: E2E regression: 3-level config chain reaches the wire
features.notes: Wire-capture MockTransport intercepts every Extract/Triage/Reason HTTP call and asserts the model name in the request body matches the resolved value. Covers program overrides winning end-to-end, tenant fallback when program is NULL, all-null falling through to settings, verifier opt-in firing a second vision call, per-program triage routing skipping Decide entirely, and precedence between program and tenant. Complements the resolver unit tests by proving inbox_hook actually threads the resolved values into each stage's config.
